title: sdks: unify auth/retries and improve streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go; parity fixes & v1.17.0 bump
author: Ava Chen
description: Unify SDK auth and retry behavior across Python, TypeScript, and Go; improve streaming ergonomics; fix parity issues and bump SDK packages to v1.17.0. Motivation: customers running cross-platform clients (web frontends + backend services) reported subtle differences in auth token refresh behavior and streaming APIs which caused inconsistent retry semantics and UX regressions. This PR consolidates the auth provider abstraction, centralizes retry logic with consistent defaults (idempotency-aware backoff), updates the streaming client ergonomics to a single canonical pattern per language, and applies parity fixes and docs/version bumps. Changes are small in each repo but cross-cutting across SDKs. Checklist: - [x] Define AuthProvider interface and implementations (env, managed token, refresh hooks) - [x] Centralize retry policy with idempotency hints and default backoff - [x] Streaming API ergonomic updates (Python: async iterator; TS: ReadableStream-friendly; Go: context-aware channel) - [x] Parity fixes (param names, default timeouts, status codes) - [x] Tests (unit + integration streaming smoke) - [x] Docs and changelogs updated - [x] Version bump and publish scripts updated
commits: feat(sdk): introduce common AuthProvider interface and token refresh hook
feat(sdk): implement unified retry middleware with idempotency support
refactor(python): streaming client -> async iterator, preserve chunk metadata
refactor(ts): expose streaming helper to pipe to ReadableStream and add backpressure hints
fix(go): propagate context to streaming transport, add cancel semantics
docs: update changelogs and quickstarts; bump versions to v1.17.0
review_comments: Miguel: Can we make the AuthProvider API backwards compatible? We need a migration path for users that subclass the old token provider.
Author (Ava): Added an adapter shim (AuthAdapter) and updated migration notes in docs. Kept old helper names with deprecation warnings.
Priya: The retry default looks aggressive for non-idempotent endpoints. Suggest adding opt-in idempotency header and more conservative defaults for user-level requests.
Author (Ava): Retry policy now checks an explicit idempotency flag and falls back to conservative retries for unknown endpoints; included tests to validate behavior.
Liam: TS streaming helper should surface backpressure control to the host runtime. Also add example for ReadableStream piping.
Author (Ava): Exposed a small 'highWaterMark' option and added a quickstart snippet in streaming.md.
release_notes:
- SDKs: unify auth provider and token refresh semantics across Python/TS/Go
- SDKs: centralize retry middleware with idempotency-aware defaults
- Streaming: improved ergonomics (Python async iterator, TS ReadableStream helper, Go context-aware channel)
- Parity fixes: aligned param names and default timeouts
- Bumped SDK package versions to v1.17.0
